# Question Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:QuestionType`](gmeow-QuestionType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/QuestionType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/inquiry`](../../slices/inquiry.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The erotetic kind of a question — a closed value vocabulary spanning polar (yes/no), alternative (which-of-a-named-set), wh (who/what/where/when), why (explanation-seeking), and how (procedure-seeking): [`gmeow:typePolar`](../individuals/gmeow-typePolar.md), [`gmeow:typeAlternative`](../individuals/gmeow-typeAlternative.md), [`gmeow:typeWh`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWh.md), [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md), [`gmeow:typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md). Its members are individuals, never subclasses, and more than one may co-apply to a single question.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:QuestionType`](gmeow-QuestionType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for the erotetic kind of a question — the closed set of question types (polar, alternative, wh, why, how) a [`Question`](gmeow-Question.md) declares through [`gmeow:questionType`](../properties/gmeow-questionType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing it to add a kind — the vocabulary is closed and its members are individuals — and avoid forcing exactly one type onto every question; [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md) and [`gmeow:typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md) may legitimately co-apply ([`gmeow:questionType`](../properties/gmeow-questionType.md) is non-functional).

### How to use

- Reference the seeded [`QuestionType`](gmeow-QuestionType.md) individuals from a [`gmeow:Question`](gmeow-Question.md) via [`gmeow:questionType`](../properties/gmeow-questionType.md), attaching as many as genuinely apply; treat the bridges ([`typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md) → abduction's explanandum, [`typeHow`](../individuals/gmeow-typeHow.md) → the procedures extension) as documented routing rather than new axioms.

### Examples

- ex:whyDidItFail [`gmeow:questionType`](../properties/gmeow-questionType.md) [`gmeow:typeWhy`](../individuals/gmeow-typeWhy.md).
